title: Data Scientist
description:
Company: Wahy Lab Solutions

Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

Job Type: Full-time Work

Mode: Work from Office

Salary: Best in Industry

Experience: Minimum 6 Months of Completed Internship

**About the Role**

Wahy Lab Solutions is looking for a motivated and analytical Data Scientist with hands-on internship experience in Data Science and Machine Learning. If you enjoy working with data, building predictive models, and solving real-world problems, this is an opportunity to take the next step in your career.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze datasets.
* Develop, train, and evaluate Machine Learning models.
* Apply statistical techniques and feature engineering to improve model performance.
* Work with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
* Write SQL queries to retrieve and analyze data.
* Create meaningful visualizations and communicate data-driven insights.
* Contribute to real-world Data Science and Machine Learning projects.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 6 months of completed internship experience in Data Science or Machine Learning.
* Strong knowledge of Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
* Good understanding of Machine Learning concepts and algorithms.
* Hands-on experience in data preprocessing, model building, and model evaluation.
* Knowledge of SQL and data visualization tools.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Candidates with relevant live projects and practical implementation experience will be preferred.

**Why Join Wahy Lab Solutions?**

* Opportunity to work on practical Data Science and Machine Learning problems.
* Scope to apply and strengthen your technical skills.
* Collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth.
* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can share their updated resume through:

Email: teamwahylab@gmail.com WhatsApp: 7994837761

Join Wahy Lab Solutions and turn data into meaningful insights!

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: AI, Machine Learning & Data Science Intern
description:

Build a foundation for future roles such as:

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hands-On Experience: Work directly with real-world datasets and end-to-end AI/ML workflows.
* Industry Tools: Gain practical proficiency in Python, Scikit-learn, SQL, and data visualization platforms.
* Solid Career Foundation: Build a strong portfolio of projects to launch your career in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

### **Apply Now to Start Your Journey in AI & Data Science!**

title: Data Science with Generative AI Intern
description:

* Assist in developing AI-powered applications and intelligent automation solutions.
* Explore Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-based information retrieval.
* Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn for data processing and modelling.
* Create data visualizations, reports, and dashboards to communicate findings.
* Collaborate with developers and project teams on live client projects.
